action.objective: Play Rc6+ to harrass the king and keep the rook active
action.rationale: c7c6 is the only commit_ready move. Verified depth-4 single-candidate search scored -12 with a full mate-in-one safety check (no mating reply, tactical_refutation not_found). Rc6+ checks the king on e6, forcing it to move; the rook attacks c1-c8 file and a6/b6/d6. Broad depth-2 search rated c7c6 top (17) though that was shallower. Alternatives a7a8b/promotions scored -32 exact, clearly worse. Play Rc6+ and keep pressing.
